summary: Blocker: AC1/revoke contract is incomplete. src/daos/syncDAO.js:89-103 filters section metadata using current access, while src/services/syncService.js:57-70 only returns purge_section_ids. After a section is relinked/unlinked, the former member never receives the required terminal section row containing the changed group_id. Major: migrations/20260722_group_section_access.sql:10 defines groups.created_by as NOT NULL with no ON DELETE SET NULL, contradicting schema.md §5.6 and preventing the required audit reference from surviving creator deletion. No implementation tests were added; package.json still contains only the failing placeholder test command.
verification: All six packet-required node --check commands passed.
Compared implementation against design source commit 3c58d79007a89e593bd89c3844f7b81b7e694788, especially design_intent.md §7-A and schema.md §5.6.
Automated tests unavailable: package.json test script is a placeholder that exits 1.
